subject.title: Package updater runs mutating doctor --fix without an explicit update option

question: What configuration-mutation contract should `openclaw update` use after replacing the package?
rationale: Current behavior favors automatic migration convergence, while the requested behavior favors explicit operator consent; source and documentation cannot determine which guarantee maintainers intend to prioritize.

options.title: Separate required migrations
options.body: Run only explicitly versioned update migrations after disclosed consent, leaving broad Doctor repairs as a separate operator action.

options.title: Require repair opt-in
options.body: Default to non-mutating checks and require an update flag such as `--allow-doctor-fix`, failing safely when repair is required.

options.title: Keep automatic repair
options.body: Treat update confirmation as authorization for Doctor repair, but disclose the exact mutating step in dry-run, JSON, and CLI documentation.

recommendation.title: Separate required migrations
recommendation.body: Run only explicitly versioned update migrations after disclosed consent, leaving broad Doctor repairs as a separate operator action.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to update/install-root repair behavior, and the unresolved choice defines a user-facing upgrade contract.
